scope: Observed per-attempt cost on the same unreviewed source-label cohort as Table 1

definitions.denominator: All attempted episodes, including wrong, uncertain and unfinished runs
definitions.wall_s: Episode wall time including processing, model calls, tools and failed requests; excludes policy-checkpoint loading before the episode
definitions.input_tokens: Sum of native input token IDs over executed model calls, including repeated history; not unique text or FLOPs
definitions.output_tokens: All generated tokens, including malformed or unused outputs
definitions.context_rejection: No forward call or tokens counted for a rejected overlength prompt; its wall time remains
definitions.tool_calls: Environment-recorded nonterminal calls; finish excluded; model parsing errors do not count as executed tools
definitions.timing_limits: Same GPU type, ordinary evaluation runs with other jobs on the host; not isolated throughput measurements
